name: Bennington County, VT
findings: Bennington County has 172 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Bennington County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Bennington County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Education organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 14 education organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do education organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 6 hobby and sports organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.
